title: Derived label
description: The sealed derivation of one generated case's labels from its parent's frozen revision and stored label transform. It has no score, and the labels are not edited by hand.

case_id.description: Generated case whose labels this revision derives. It is also the label id.

parent_stream_id.description: Parent stream whose frozen revision supplied the labels.

parent_revision_sha256.description: Seal of the parent's annotation revision. A track case's label_revision is this seal.

parent_label_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the parent label document.

label_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the derived label document.

source_sha256.description: Source hash the parent labels name.

transform_kind.description: Stored label-transform kind that produced these labels.

label_transform_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the stored label transform.

timestamp_quality.description: derived when the case changes presentation time. Null when the case does not.

x-rules.score: This record has no score. An unscorable parent is not sealed as zero.
x-rules.hand: The derived label document is produced by the command. It is not edited by hand.
